name: uptimemonk
description: Root workspace: tooling for scripts/ and the emulator. App code lives in functions/ and web/.

scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && node scripts/test-monitoring-features.mjs && node scripts/test-all-features.mjs
scripts.test:types: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.deploy:admin: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && npm --prefix admin run build && npx --no-install firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:uptimemonke-admin
scripts.test:status: npm --prefix server run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-uptimemonk "node --test server/test/status-page.test.mjs"
